sku_type.note: babybath's dict identity column is sku_type (there is NO sku_type_complete column on this table; the QA table's sku_type_complete is populated from this value). sub_brand already carries the brand prefix (e.g. 'Cussons Baby Milk Bath Refill'), so brand is NOT concatenated again. Empty sources are NOT skipped: the dominant production convention is a raw CONCAT with a single-space separator, so an empty `function` leaves a literal double space (e.g. 'BOMI Body Wash Bloom  400 ml'). That exact-concat form holds on 1767/2012 rows; the remaining ~245 are legacy drift (single space when function is empty, or a scent/variant folded into sku_type that never made it into `function`). New rows follow the 1767-row majority convention so downstream exact-string joins on sku_type keep matching.

keywords.note: Holds on 2010/2012 rows. When keywords_typo is empty/null, keywords is a verbatim copy of sku_type; otherwise the typo string is prefixed (e.g. keywords_typo='250ml' -> '250ml MS Kids Baby Shampoo Mild Honey 250 ml').

packsize.note: Not strictly generated, but strongly conventionalised: '<number> <unit>' with a space, unit lowercase ('100 ml', '75 gr', '1000 ml'). For bundle_type='multipack' the suffix ' x <n> pcs' is appended ('400 ml x 3 pcs'); a shorter ' x <n>' form also exists in legacy rows. Multi-item bundles join components with ' + ' ('180 ml + 50 gr').

ingredients.note: When no ingredient is known, every ingredient_N column and `ingredients` are set to the literal 'Not Available' (the dominant production convention), not left empty.
